correctness.rationale: The explicit two-geometric-block sum computes the zero ambiguity frequencies for every N and r; finite Weyl Fourier orthogonality yields exactly m independent even-order skew-antipodal Hermitian kernel blocks. Any s nonzero blocks have rank 2s, so only single blocks can equal a difference of two rank-one projectors. The scalar probe pairs nontrivially with every such block precisely for nonzero imaginary antipodal products. Both directions and boundaries N=2, odd N were checked algebraically; numerical N<=12 is corroboration only.

value.rationale: A sharp one-outcome repair for a natural positive full-support Gabor window resolves every even-order phase ambiguity, despite an arbitrarily growing N/2-dimensional matrix nullspace. An exact iff condition allows design of all working added measurements and distinguishes universal nonlinear phase retrieval from full linear informational completeness. This is a natural structural recovery theorem, not an arbitrary fixed-size parameter count.
